user.title: Set up Schoolday
user.description: Schoolday puts the school timetable and the daily routines on your dashboards. After setup, use Configure to add your family members, the lesson times and everybody's week.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Schoolday is already set up. Use Configure on the existing entry to change your family.

init.title: Schoolday
init.description: Changes are saved as you make them. You can do several in a row.

routines.title: Choose a routine
routines.description: Pick the family member and the time of day. The next step is where the steps per weekday go.

routine_steps.title: {name} – {block}
routine_steps.description:
One step per line. Empty days have no routine.

The last two fields are the days that are not school days: a holiday morning is not a school morning with items crossed out, it is its own short list. A child in holiday care gets the care list; leave it empty and the day off list is used for those days too.

Routines stay independent of the timetable: "pack the PE kit" belongs to the evening before, so put it on the days that have PE.

timetable_times.title: Lesson times
timetable_times.description:
One period per line, as HH:MM-HH:MM:

08:00-08:45
08:45-09:30
09:50-10:35

Breaks are not entered anywhere: every gap of five minutes or more between two periods is drawn as a break by itself.

data_description.periods: The order does not matter, they are sorted by their start time. Emptying this field hides the timetable card.

timetable_lessons.title: Whose timetable?
timetable_lessons.description: Pick the family member. The next step is their whole week. The lessons are shown on the Schoolday Timetable card in that member's colours.

timetable_week.title: {name} – timetable
timetable_week.description:
One lesson per line, in the order of the periods:

{periods}

The room goes after a vertical bar, a dash leaves a period free, and a line may name its own period so a late start needs no filler:

German
Maths | 1.OG 5
-
6. PE | Gym

Subjects pick their own colour. Days you leave empty simply have no school.

timetable_colors.title: Subject colours
timetable_colors.description: Every subject already has a colour, derived from its name, and it is the same colour for every child. Change the ones you would like to be different.

timetable_calendars.title: Days off and holiday care
timetable_calendars.description:
A timetable repeats forever; holidays do not. Name the calendars that close the school — a subscribed school-holiday calendar, or a local one for teacher training days.

Any event running on those calendars means today has no school: the week stays on the card as the plan it is, but today's lessons go quiet, the sensor reads `free`, and no lesson events fire. Point this at calendars that hold nothing but days off — anything else on them would shut the school for the afternoon.

Holiday care is a day off with somewhere to be, so it gets its own routine. It is found by keyword on each child's own calendar, set under Edit a family member. One keyword per line, matched anywhere in the event's title, upper or lower case.

data_description.care_keywords: For example "Holiday club". Leave empty if you do not use holiday care — then there are no care days.

timetable_materials.title: What each subject needs
timetable_materials.description: One thing per line. They are added to the evening routine on the day before that subject, for whoever has it — so nobody has to keep a packing list in step with the timetable.

error.invalid_period: "{line}" is not a time range. Write every line as HH:MM-HH:MM, for example 08:00-08:45.

abort.member_not_found: That family member no longer exists.

remove_member.name: Remove a family member
remove_member.description: Remove a member, along with their timetable and routines.

reset_routine.name: Reset routine
reset_routine.description: Clears today's ticks, for one member or for everyone.

set_absent.name: Mark ill
set_absent.description: Close the school day for one child. Their lessons empty out, their routine falls silent and the morning announcement skips them.

absent.name: Ill
absent.description: Off says they are better again.

until.name: Until
until.description: The last day of the absence, today included. Left empty it means today.

set_calendars.name: Set days off and holiday care
set_calendars.description: Name the calendars that close the school and the words that mean holiday care.

school_calendars.name: Calendars
school_calendars.description: Any event running on these means there is no school.

care_keywords.name: Holiday-care keywords
care_keywords.description: Matched against events on each member's own calendar.

set_day.name: Set a whole day
set_day.description: Replace one member's lessons for one weekday.

lessons.name: Lessons
lessons.description: A list of entries with period, subject and optional room.

set_lesson.name: Set a lesson
set_lesson.description: Put one subject in one period of one day, or clear it.

subject.name: Subject
subject.description: Leave empty to clear the period.

room.name: Room
room.description: Optional room, shown under the subject.

set_materials.name: Set what a subject needs
set_materials.description: Say what a subject needs brought along. These are added to the evening routine on the day before that subject, and tick off like any other step.

subject.name: Subject
subject.description: The subject, spelled as in the timetable.

items.name: Things to pack
items.description: One per entry. An empty list stops asking for anything.

set_member.name: Add or edit a family member
set_member.description: Add a family member, or change one that already exists.

member.name: Member
member.description: Leave empty to add somebody new; give a name or id to change them.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name shown on the cards.

color.name: Colour
color.description: The member's colour, used across every card.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: This member's own calendar, searched for the holiday-care keywords.

set_periods.name: Set lesson times
set_periods.description: Replace the household's lesson times. Breaks are the gaps between them.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: One HH:MM-HH:MM per entry, for example 08:00-08:45.

set_routine.name: Set routine steps
set_routine.description: Replace one member's steps for one block on one day.

day.name: Day
day.description: A weekday 0-6, or free for a day off and care for holiday care.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: One step per entry. An empty list clears the day.

set_routine_step.name: Set routine step
set_routine_step.description: Tick a routine step off for today, or put it back.

step.name: Step
step.description: The step, exactly as configured in the routine.

done.name: Done
done.description: True ticks it off, false puts it back.

set_subject_color.name: Set a subject colour
set_subject_color.description: Recolour one subject. Clearing it hands back the colour derived from its name.

subject.name: Subject
subject.description: The subject, exactly as it is spelled in the timetable.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Leave empty to go back to the derived colour.
